scripts.git:push: git add . && git commit -m 'feat: 🔖 Bump version' && git push
scripts.publish:ios:patch: npx react-native bump-version --type patch && yarn git:push && yarn build:ios && yarn submit:ios
scripts.publish:ios:minor: npx react-native bump-version --type minor && yarn git:push && yarn build:ios && yarn submit:ios
scripts.publish:ios:major: npx react-native bump-version --type major && yarn git:push && yarn build:ios && yarn submit:ios
scripts.publish:android:patch: npx react-native bump-version --type patch && yarn git:push && yarn build:android && yarn submit:android
scripts.publish:android:minor: npx react-native bump-version --type minor && yarn git:push && yarn build:android && yarn submit:android
scripts.publish:android:major: npx react-native bump-version --type major && yarn git:push && yarn build:android && yarn submit:android
scripts.publish:all:patch: npx react-native bump-version --type patch && yarn git:push && yarn build:all && yarn submit:all
scripts.publish:all:minor: npx react-native bump-version --type minor && yarn git:push && yarn build:all && yarn submit:all
scripts.publish:all:major: npx react-native bump-version --type major && yarn git:push && yarn build:all && yarn submit:all
scripts.pods:install: if [ -d "ios" ]; then cd ios && pod install && cd ..; fi
scripts.pods:update: if [ -d "ios" ]; then cd ios && pod update && cd ..; fi
scripts.pods:clean: if [ -d "ios" ]; then cd ios && rm -rf Pods && rm -rf Podfile.lock && pod deintegrate && pod install && cd ..; fi
